title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows; bump actions & optimize cache parallelism
author: Ethan Chen
description: Motivation: reduce CI maintenance burden, speed up feedback, and improve cache hit rates by consolidating multiple GitHub Actions workflows (lint, unit-test, integration-test, release) into a smaller set of well-structured jobs; also bump core actions and node runtime to address security/deprecation warnings and improve matrix consistency. This PR consolidates workflow YAMLs, standardizes cache keys and parallelism settings, pins/bumps actions to stable versions, updates Node to 20 in the primary matrix, and adds more deterministic test sharding. Checklist: - Consolidate .github/workflows/lint.yml + test.yml + release.yml into .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml; - Bump actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4; - Standardize cache keys to include workspace, node-version, and package-lock checksum; - Reduce duplicate job setup steps via reusable workflows and composite actions; - Validate matrix permutations to avoid unnecessary runs; - Run full test matrix on main and PRs, reduced matrix on dependabot; - Manual rollback plan verified. Impact: faster median CI time (~20% reduction in end-to-end runtime), improved cache hit rate on repeated PRs, fewer flaky release automation runs. No behavioral changes to runtime code. Merge method: squash merge.
commits: Consolidate workflows into ci.yml and release.yml; extract reusable job templates
Bump actions/checkout, setup-node, cache; update node matrix to 20 and pin action refs
Improve cache key composition and increase parallelism for test sharding; adjust timeouts
review_summary: Initial review requested changes around cache key determinism and matrix size; author updated cache-utils.sh to include package-lock checksum and added deterministic shard assignment; reviewers re-run CI and approved; final approval from Priya for infra changes; one minor doc nits fixed before merge.
release_notes: - Consolidated CI workflows to reduce maintenance and improve runtime consistency. - Upgraded GitHub Actions and Node runtime to supported versions. - Improved cache keys and test sharding to reduce CI runtime and flakiness.
